Fun Fact: "Nigger" was an early word used to refer to lower class workers. Before it meant "black person" (in Canada) it typically meant someone who came to Canada from Ireland during the famine, and had so little money they had to sell their service for years to a farmer in exchange for basic necessities, i.e. food and shelter. Although the term was degrading, and meant slave, race had nothing to do with it, as it could be applied to anyone working as a "handy man" of sorts.

TL;DR "nigger" wasn't always racist.
